title: File:Frailties of fashion (BM 1868,0808.6292 2).jpg
art:
Print made by: Isaac Cruikshank

Published by: S W Fores
desc: A satire on the fashion for dress projecting in front to give the effect of pregnancy.  A promenade in a park.  On the extreme left is a little girl holding a doll, both dressed in the prevailing fashion. Next walks (left to right) the Prince of Wales between Mrs. Fitzherbert (left) and the Duchess
